g.text: sphinx-asr: runtime packaging, removed Docker image (Mar 24-26 2026) vs current native venv
pip install pyyaml numpy scipy (first run)
Why it was dropped (commit history + README note
"maybe remove docker"): corpora and experiment trees
are hundreds of GB of host data, SphinxTrain scripts
expect real paths, and the Python wrapper, CMU SLM
toolkit, numpy/scipy for MLLT were never in the image.
The image also had no sphinx-asr Python deps and
For the ivalice cluster this is the relevant model:
build bin/aarch64 on a CM4 (never cross-compile on
macOS), and keep .venv + bin + corpus on the shared
/srv/ivalice path once NFS exists. Podman is installed
on every node if a container route is revisited.
